title: D-GO App Features
lead: Manage your vault with D-GO Vault Management and protect your data with D-GO Secure Folder.

vault.title: D-GO Vault Management
vault.description: Monitor the status of your connected vault through the app.

folder.title: D-GO Secure Folder
folder.description: Protect files and audio recordings, timestamp documents, provide proof of document viewing, and manage keys and certificates.

encryption.title: Data Encryption & Decryption
encryption.description: Encrypt data and decrypt it for use.

timestamp.title: Document Timestamping
timestamp.description: Verify that a document existed at a specific point in time.

documentAccess.title: Proof of Document Viewing
documentAccess.description: Provides evidence that a document was viewed.
